question: Rechungma, Gha To Kito and Chi Rmu are the dance forms of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Dance forms of Sikkim**

__
 
• Folk songs and dances are an inveterate part of the Sikkimese culture.
 
• Most of the tribal dances depict the harvest season and they are performed for prosperity.
 
• The dances of Sikkim are accompanied by traditional musical instruments, and chanting, and the dancers carry bright costumes and traditional masks.
 
• Some of the **most famous dance forms are Rechungma, Gha To Kito, Chi Rmu, Be Yu Mista, Tashi Zaldha, Enchey Chaam, Lu Khangthamo, Gnungmala Gnunghey, and Kagyed Dance.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Dance forms of Manipur, Andaman and Nicobar and Goa

 
• Manipur has many styles of dance ranging from folk to classical and modern.
 
• The **primary forms of Manipuri** are the **Raas Leela, a classical Indian dance form, Jagoi, Cholom and Thang-Ta.**
 
• **Nicobari dance is the traditional dance of Andaman and Nicobar.**
 
• It can be seen during the Ossuary Feast, commonly known as the Pig Festival.
 
• **Dhalo is a popular ritual folk dance form Goa**, India. The dance is performed by women and serves as a prayer of protection for their households.
